test_title: PYST 120: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held On - 23 Jan, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, ‘POWDER’ is written as ‘QPXEFS’ and ‘SHAMPOO’ is written as ‘TIBNQPP’. How will ‘PERFUME’ be written in that language?
solution:
Here, we use the table given below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b0fc3f56e3fd57aad7dd2548de171e9d50194ed2720488b80293f51fe809f843.png] 

**Logic:** (1) is added to the positional values in each alphabet.

‘POWDER’ is written as ‘QPXEFS’ →

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2509b1991fa85d754f217a30b5d0449ad9509feb77abc063ee4ea31669f286b3.png] 

‘SHAMPOO’ is written as ‘TIBNQPP’ →

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e9b87061a202302937a8d81221f43d5d6b0b7065b0756b844566871317e8f6c7.png] 

Similarly, 'PERFUME' will be written as:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/555cdae4c2dbf66fceff2a31d59cc8b27fdbc57207805add21b3f3abb1a59fcc.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "**QFSGVNF**".
